name: The Restless Souls
label: Quest
description: The Restless Souls: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I draw my power - my will to continue living and breathing - from the unmitigated hatred I have for the Scourge and all that they have done. I am, however, no zealot. There are those, like the Scarlet Crusade, who would sooner destroy the innocent undead than lend them even an ounce of compassion.
Which brings me to this: My blaster. It will unchain the tortured souls from Stratholme.
Use it on the ghosts that haunt the ransacked streets. Free their souls.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Compassion is what separates us from the animals, friend. Remember that...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Did you see my mother, friend? Did you free her?
You are a shining example of decency. For your troubles...
